`````html
      content:"";position:absolute;inset:-55% -15% -35%;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;
      background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 12% 95%,#ffe5a3 0 12%,transparent 32%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 38% 105%,#ffd275 0 18%,transparent 40%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 65% 95%,#fff0b6 0 12%,transparent 33%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 105%,#ffc869 0 18%,transparent 40%);
      opacity:.75;transform-origin:center bottom;animation:flambeFlames 8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .flambe-button::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:1px;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;border-radius:inherit;border:1px solid rgba(255,237,160,.55);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,238,181,.2),transparent 60%)}
    .flambe-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #773414;outline-offset:4px}
    @keyframes flambeSurface{0%,100%{background-position:0% 50%;box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,150,51,.34),0 7px 25px rgba(184,72,16,.24)}50%{background-position:100% 50%;box-shadow:0 0 23px rgba(255,161,59,.5),0 7px 30px rgba(190,80,18,.32)}}
    @keyframes flambeFlames{0%,100%{transform:translate(-3%,5%) scaleY(.92)}50%{transform:translate(3%,-4%) scaleY(1.12)}}
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.flambe-button,.flambe-button::before{animation:none}}
    @media(forced-colors:active){.flambe-button,.flambe-button:hover,.flambe-button:focus-visible{animation:none;background:ButtonFace;color:ButtonText;border:1px solid ButtonText;box-shadow:none;text-shadow:none}.flambe-button::before,.flambe-button::after{display:none}}
    .ceniciento-frame.sonrisa-transition{opacity:0;transition:opacity 2s ease-in-out;background:transparent}
    .ceniciento-frame.sonrisa-transition.sonrisa-visible{opacity:1}
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ceniciento-frame.sonrisa-transition{transition-duration:.2s}}
    html.ceniciento-open,body.ceniciento-open{overflow:hidden}
    body.ceniciento-open:not(.sonrisa-open) > :not(iframe):not(audio):not(script){visibility:hidden}
    .portrait-question{
      position:absolute;left:30%;top:44%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
      display:grid;place-items:center;width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;
      padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;touch-action:manipulation;z-index:1;
      color:#342719;font:400 2rem/1 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;
      opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;
      transition:opacity 3s ease 25s,visibility 0s linear 25s;
    }
    .question-beat{
      display:grid;place-items:center;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,246,225,.65);background:rgba(238,241,233,.92);
      box-shadow:0 5px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.24);pointer-events:none;
      animation:questionHeartbeat var(--pulse-duration) linear infinite;will-change:transform;
    }
    @keyframes questionHeartbeat{
      0%{transform:scale(var(--question-current))}
      10%{transform:scale(calc(var(--question-first) * 1.12))}
      18%{transform:scale(var(--question-first))}
      33%{transform:scale(calc(var(--question-next) * 1.08))}
      44%,100%{transform:scale(var(--question-next))}
    }
    .portrait-question:hover .question-beat{background:#fff9ec}
    .portrait-question:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff9ec;outline-offset:4px}
    body.voice-open .portrait-image-area{width:100vw}
    body.portrait-revealed .voice-dialog{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity 10s ease}
    body.portrait-revealed .voice-launch{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
    body.portrait-revealed .portrait-finale{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
    body.portrait-revealed .portrait-finale img{opacity:1}
    body.portrait-revealed .portrait-question{opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto}
    body.reading-ready.portrait-revealed main{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity 6s ease,visibility 6s ease}
    @media(max-width:900px){
      body.voice-open .voice-dialog{position:relative;top:auto;bottom:auto;right:auto;margin:24px 16px 0 auto}
      body.voice-open main{width:calc(100% - 34px);margin:0 auto;padding-top:20svh}
      body.voice-open .portrait-image-area{width:100vw}
    }
    @media(max-width:700px){
      .portrait-question{width:80px;height:80px;transition:opacity 2.5s ease 10s,visibility 0s linear 10s}
      .question-beat{width:56px;height:56px}
    }
    @media(hover:none) and (pointer:coarse){.question-beat{animation:none}}

    /* PRELUDIO ANA -> KLAUDYA */
    .name-prelude{
      position:fixed;
      inset:0;
      z-index:25;
      display:grid;
      place-items:center;
      pointer-events:none;
      opacity:0;
      visibility:hidden;
      transition:opacity 1.4s ease,visibility 1.4s ease;
    }

    body.prelude .name-prelude{
      opacity:1;
      visibility:visible;
    }

    .name-line{
      margin:0;
      width:max-content;
      max-width:calc(100vw - 44px);
      text-align:center;
      font-size:clamp(2rem,4.8vw,3rem);
      line-height:1.15;
      font-weight:500;
      letter-spacing:.012em;
    }

    .name-ana,
    .name-klaudya{
      display:inline-block;
      opacity:0;
      filter:blur(5px);
      transition:
        opacity 2.15s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),
        filter 2.15s ease,
        transform 2.15s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
    }

    .name-ana{transform:translateX(-9px)}
    .name-klaudya{margin-left:.34em;transform:translateX(12px)}

    .name-prelude.show-ana .name-ana,
    .name-prelude.show-klaudya .name-klaudya{
      opacity:1;
      filter:blur(0);
      transform:none;
    }

    .name-prelude.fade{opacity:0!important}

    /* AUDIO */
    .sound-toggle{
      position:fixed;
      left:max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-left));
      bottom:max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
      z-index:35;
      width:42px;
      height:42px;
      border:1px solid rgba(23,63,50,.19);
      border-radius:50%;
      display:grid;
      place-items:center;
      padding:0;
      background:rgba(247,246,236,.76);
      color:#173f32;
      cursor:pointer;
      opacity:0;
      visibility:hidden;
      pointer-events:none;
      -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      box-shadow:0 5px 22px rgba(8,49,32,.08);
      transition:opacity .55s ease,transform .4s ease;
    }

    body.sound-ready .sound-toggle{
      opacity:.72;
      visibility:visible;
      pointer-events:auto;
    }

    .sound-toggle:hover,
    .sound-toggle:focus-visible{
      opacity:1!important;
      transform:scale(1.05);
      outline:none;
    }

    .sound-toggle svg{width:19px;height:19px}
    .sound-off{display:none}
    .sound-toggle.is-muted .sound-on{display:none}
    .sound-toggle.is-muted .sound-off{display:block}
    .sound-toggle path,.sound-toggle circle{
      fill:none;
      stroke:currentColor;
      stroke-width:1.55;
      stroke-linecap:round;
      stroke-linejoin:round;
    }

    /* LECTURA */
    main{
      position:relative;
      z-index:10;
      width:min(calc(100% - 42px),760px);
      margin:0 auto;
      padding:62svh 0 22svh;
      opacity:0;
      visibility:hidden;
      transition:opacity 1.7s ease,visibility 1.7s ease;
    }

    body.reading-ready main{
      opacity:1;
      visibility:visible;
    }

    .poem{
      width:min(100%,39ch);
      margin:0 auto;
      font-size:clamp(1.28rem,2.75vw,1.72rem);
      line-height:1.48;
      letter-spacing:.003em;
    }

    .line{
      --gap:10svh;
      display:block;
      width:max-content;
      max-width:100%;
      margin-top:var(--gap);
      opacity:0;
      transform:translateY(.55em);
      filter:blur(.48px);
      transition:
        opacity 1.45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),
        transform 1.45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),
        filter 1.3s ease,
        color .18s linear,
        text-shadow .18s linear;
    }

    .line:first-child{margin-top:0}

    .line.is-shown{
      opacity:1;
      transform:none;
      filter:none;
    }

    /* RESPIRACIÓN DEL POEMA */
    .g-close{--gap:7svh}
    .g-soft{--gap:11svh}
    .g-comma{--gap:15svh}
    .g-sentence{--gap:24svh}
    .g-turn{--gap:34svh}
    .g-deep{--gap:46svh}

    .g-opening-2{--gap:22svh}
    .g-eyes-2{--gap:48svh}
    .g-subraya-2{--gap:28svh}

    .g-music-2a{--gap:14svh}
    .g-music-2b{--gap:14svh}

    .g-reflection-open{--gap:108svh}
    .g-reflection-thought{--gap:30svh}
    .g-reflection-suspense{--gap:22svh}
    .g-reflection-voice{--gap:38svh}

    .g-embrace-a{--gap:48svh}
    .g-embrace-b{--gap:20svh}
    .g-embrace-c{--gap:62svh}
    .g-embrace-d{--gap:38svh}

    /* Preserve the final reveal space without a repeated signature. */
    .poem::after{content:"";display:block;height:120svh;pointer-events:none}

    .voice-word{
      position:relative;
      white-space:nowrap;
    }

    .voice-word::after{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      left:0;
      right:0;
      bottom:-.12em;
      height:1px;
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(35,90,52,.30),rgba(111,142,85,.18));
      transform:scaleX(.72);
      transform-origin:left;
    }

    .heat-one{
      color:#9d5a2a;
      text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(213,113,32,.08);
    }

    /* CIERRE: "el" -> "calor."; keep its space when the words become fixed. */
    .heat-anchor{
      display:block;
      padding-top:58svh;
      min-height:calc(58svh + 2.08em);
      font-size:clamp(2.25rem,5.8vw,3.85rem);
    }
    .heat-final{
      position:relative;
      --gap:0;
      margin-bottom:0;
      font-size:clamp(2.25rem,5.8vw,3.85rem);
      line-height:1.04;
      font-weight:500;
      letter-spacing:.012em;
      color:rgb(var(--heat-r) var(--heat-g) var(--heat-b));
      -webkit-text-stroke:.25px rgba(255,224,192,.18);
      text-shadow:
        0 0 2px rgba(75,38,34,.62),
        0 0 calc(1px + 5px * var(--heat-glow)) rgba(255,170,104,calc(.05 + .26 * var(--heat-glow))),
        0 -1px calc(2px + 9px * var(--heat-glow)) rgba(255,222,158,calc(.04 + .20 * var(--heat-glow))),
        0 2px calc(1px + 4px * var(--heat-glow)) rgba(112,61,55,calc(.06 + .18 * var(--heat-glow)));
    }

    .heat-final.is-shown{
      position:fixed;
      left:50%;
      top:50%;
      z-index:24;
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      margin:0;
      transform:translate(-50%,-50%)!important;
      max-width:calc(100vw - 32px);
      text-align:center;
      line-height:.84;
      pointer-events:none;
    }

    .heat-part{
      display:block;
      width:max-content;
      line-height:.84;
      opacity:0;
      filter:blur(5px);
      transition:
        opacity 2.15s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),
        filter 2.15s ease,
        transform 2.15s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
    }

    .heat-el{
      transform:translateX(-12px);
    }

    .heat-calor{
      margin-top:-.16em;
      transform:translateX(14px);
    }

    .heat-final.is-shown .heat-el,
    .heat-final.show-calor .heat-calor{
      opacity:1;
      filter:blur(0);
      transform:none;
    }

    .heat-final.is-burning{
      animation:heatBreath 1.25s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    @keyframes heatBreath{
      0%{filter:brightness(1) saturate(1)}
      52%{filter:brightness(1.06) saturate(1.05)}
      100%{filter:brightness(1.02) saturate(1.10)}
    }

    .signature{
      font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;
      font-size:.68rem;
      letter-spacing:.19em;
      color:rgba(32,29,25,.38);
    }

    .scroll-cue{
      position:fixed;
      left:50%;
      bottom:5.2svh;
      z-index:18;
      width:8px;
      height:8px;
      border-right:1px solid rgba(32,29,25,.34);
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(32,29,25,.34);
      transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);
      opacity:0;
      visibility:hidden;
      pointer-events:none;
      transition:opacity .7s ease,visibility .7s ease;
      animation:cue 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    body.reading-ready:not(.has-scrolled) .scroll-cue{
      opacity:.62;
      visibility:visible;
    }

    @keyframes cue{
      0%,100%{translate:0 0}
      50%{translate:0 7px}
    }

    @media(max-width:640px){
      main{
        width:min(calc(100% - 34px),760px);
        padding-top:64svh;
      }

      .poem{
        width:min(100%,31ch);
        font-size:clamp(1.18rem,5.2vw,1.48rem);
        line-height:1.5;
      }

      .g-close{--gap:8svh}
      .g-soft{--gap:12svh}
      .g-comma{--gap:16svh}
      .g-sentence{--gap:25svh}
      .g-turn{--gap:35svh}
      .g-deep{--gap:47svh}

      .g-opening-2{--gap:24svh}
      .g-eyes-2{--gap:50svh}
      .g-subraya-2{--gap:32svh}
      .g-music-2a{--gap:16svh}
      .g-music-2b{--gap:16svh}

      .g-reflection-open{--gap:100svh}
      .g-reflection-thought{--gap:28svh}
      .g-reflection-suspense{--gap:20svh}
      .g-reflection-voice{--gap:36svh}

      .g-embrace-a{--gap:50svh}
      .g-embrace-b{--gap:22svh}
      .g-embrace-c{--gap:66svh}
      .g-embrace-d{--gap:40svh}

      .heat-final{
        --gap:54svh;
        font-size:clamp(2.15rem,9.5vw,3.25rem);
      }

      .poem::after{height:112svh}
    }

    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
      html{scroll-behavior:auto}
      .entry,.name-prelude,.name-ana,.name-klaudya,.line,.heat-part,.sound-toggle,main{transition-duration:.01ms}
      .pulse-field,.pulse-field::before,.pulse-field::after,.question-beat{animation-duration:3.8s}
      .layer-warm{animation:none}
      .heat-final.is-burning{animation:none}
      .scroll-cue{animation:none}
    }
  body.eyes-open *,body.eyes-open *::before,body.eyes-open *::after{animation-play-state:paused!important}

/* Recorrido y lectura en vertical. */
.journey-nav[hidden]{display:none!important}
.journey-nav{position:fixed;z-index:160;left:50%;bottom:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px;background:rgba(16,15,14,.18);color:#fffaf1;border:1px solid rgba(255,250,241,.42);border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 3px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.16);-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none;max-width:calc(100% - 24px)}
.journey-nav button{min-height:44px;min-width:74px;margin:0;padding:10px 14px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:14px/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.85);cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
.journey-nav button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
.journey-nav button:focus-visible,.entry-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #375548;outline-offset:3px}
.journey-index{box-sizing:border-box;width:min(540px,calc(100% - 24px));max-height:calc(100svh - 24px);border:1px solid #596457;border-radius:18px;padding:44px 16px 12px;background:#19231d;color:#f0eadf;z-index:170;overflow:auto}
.journey-index::backdrop{background:#101a15aa}
.journey-index .ana-navigation{position:static;transform:none;width:100%;max-width:none;max-height:none;overflow:visible;box-shadow:none;border:0;padding:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:5px}
.journey-index .ana-navigation[hidden]{display:none}
.journey-index .entry-button{text-align:left;font:14px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;box-shadow:none;border-radius:8px;border-color:#ced3cb;padding:8px 12px;min-height:44px}
/* Cada entrada anticipa la imagen y el tono de su pieza. */
.journey-index .entry-button.piece-button{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;width:100%;margin:0;min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;background:var(--piece-tone,#26342d);border-color:var(--piece-border,#637065);color:#fff7e9;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #0008;animation:none}
.piece-button .piece-art{position:absolute;z-index:-2;inset:0 0 0 auto;width:60%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;opacity:.94}
.piece-button .piece-art svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
.piece-button .piece-label{position:relative;max-width:82%;font-weight:500}
.piece-button .piece-shade{position:absolute;z-index:-1;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--piece-tone) 0%,var(--piece-tone) 35%,var(--piece-veil) 65%,transparent 100%)}
#anaEstrella{--piece-tone:#172837;--piece-veil:#172837d9;--piece-border:#526479}
#anaRead{--piece-tone:#493827;--piece-veil:#493827d9;--piece-border:#8d7153}
#anaOjos{--piece-tone:#263d32;--piece-veil:#263d32d9;--piece-border:#657d69}
#anaSonrisa{--piece-tone:#4f2d38;--piece-veil:#4f2d38d9;--piece-border:#997180}
#anaCabello{--piece-tone:#201e1c;--piece-veil:#201e1cd9;--piece-border:#716253}
#anaPiel{--piece-tone:#5a3b28;--piece-veil:#5a3b28d9;--piece-border:#a1805b}
#anaInterlude{--piece-tone:#493c38;--piece-veil:#493c38d9;--piece-border:#a78878}
#anaVoice{--piece-tone:#233b40;--piece-veil:#233b40d9;--piece-border:#658388}
.journey-index .entry-button.petal-button.piece-button{background:var(--piece-tone);border-color:var(--piece-border);color:#fff7e9}
.journey-index .piece-button:hover,.journey-index .piece-button:focus-visible{background:var(--piece-tone);border-color:#dfc69b;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #dfc69b;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.journey-index .entry-button.flambe-button{width:100%;margin:0;min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;border-color:#ed993d;color:#321609;font-weight:500}
.journey-index .entry-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #dfc69b;outline-offset:3px}
@media(max-width:480px){.journey-index{padding-left:12px;padding-right:12px}.journey-index .entry-button.piece-button,.journey-index .entry-button.flambe-button{padding:8px 10px}}
@media(max-height:650px){.journey-index .ana-navigation{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.journey-index .piece-button .piece-label{max-width:100%}.journey-index .piece-button .piece-art{opacity:.6}.journey-index .piece-button .piece-shade{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--piece-tone),var(--piece-veil))}.journey-index #anaVoice{grid-column:1/-1}}
@media(min-width:600px) and (max-height:650px){.journey-index{width:min(720px,calc(100% - 24px))}.journey-index .ana-navigation{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.journey-index #anaVoice{grid-column:auto}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.journey-index .entry-button{animation:none;transition:none;transform:none}}
@media(forced-colors:active){.piece-button .piece-art,.piece-button .piece-shade{display:none}.journey-index .entry-button.piece-button,.journey-index .entry-button.petal-button.piece-button,.journey-index .entry-button.flambe-button{background:ButtonFace;color:ButtonText;text-shadow:none;border-color:ButtonText}.journey-index .entry-button:focus-visible{outline-color:Highlight}}
.journey-index-close{position:absolute;top:0;right:6px;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;background:transparent;border:0;color:inherit;font:22px system-ui;cursor:pointer}
.entry{background:#eef1e9;backdrop-filter:none}
.entry-flag{font:italic 16px/1.5 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:0;color:#415248}
body.journey-started main{padding-bottom:130px}
.epilogue-invitation{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:480px){.journey-nav{box-sizing:border-box;width:min(calc(100% - 24px),420px);max-width:calc(100% - 24px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;padding:4px;border-radius:16px}.journey-nav button{min-width:0;min-height:48px;padding:8px 4px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:13px}body.journey-started main{padding-bottom:240px}.entry-title{font-size:clamp(27px,8vw,42px)}.voice-dialog{top:auto;bottom:78px;max-height:45svh;padding:18px}body.voice-open main{width:calc(100% - 34px);margin:auto}.voice-dialog h2{font-size:20px}.voice-launch{min-height:44px}}
/* En móvil, los tres controles ocupan una sola fila también en pantallas de 481–760 px. */
@media(max-width:760px){.journey-nav{box-sizing:border-box;width:min(calc(100% - 24px),420px);max-width:calc(100% - 24px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:4px;padding:4px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(16,15,14,.18);color:#fffaf1;border-color:rgba(255,250,241,.42);box-shadow:0 3px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.16);-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none}.journey-nav button{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-width:0;max-width:100%;min-height:48px;padding:8px 4px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:clamp(11px,3.4vw,13px)}body.journey-started .ou-card{width:86px;height:54px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(62,68,77,.58),rgba(20,24,30,.52));backdrop-filter:blur(2px);opacity:.88}body.journey-started .ou-card::before{left:12px;top:10px;width:22px;height:16px}body.journey-started .ou-card::after{left:12px;right:12px;bottom:9px;height:2px;box-shadow:0 -7px 0 rgba(246,244,238,.33),0 -14px 0 rgba(246,244,238,.13)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.world *,.question-beat{animation:none!important}.portrait-finale,.portrait-finale img{transition:none!important}}
@media print{.journey-nav,.journey-index{display:none!important}}

.ceniciento-frame.sonrisa-transition.interlude-transition{transition-duration:.5s}

/* Petals bridge the quiet body poems and the amber of the epilogue. */
.petal-button,.journey-index .entry-button.petal-button{
 position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:#4e3b32;border-color:#c9ac8c;
 background:linear-gradient(115deg,#f4eee3 0%,#ead6cf 40%,#ecd8ba 76%,#f4dfa9 100%);
 box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #fff8;
}
.petal-button:hover,.petal-button:focus-visible{background:linear-gradient(115deg,#f9f1e6,#edd4ce 40%,#f3d8ab);border-color:#aa8464}
.petal-mark{display:inline-flex;flex:none;width:25px;height:25px}.petal-mark svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
.journey-nav{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.journey-nav button[hidden]{display:none}
@media(forced-colors:active){.petal-button,.journey-index .entry-button.petal-button{background:ButtonFace;color:ButtonText;border:1px solid ButtonText}.petal-mark{display:none}}


html.poem-route-loading,html.poem-route-loading body{background:#080706}
html.poem-route-loading::after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:155;background:#080706;pointer-events:none}
.poem-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:95;background:#080706;opacity:1;pointer-events:none;transition:none}
.poem-backdrop[hidden]{display:none!important}
.poem-backdrop.is-leaving{opacity:0;transition:opacity 2s ease-in-out}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.poem-backdrop.is-leaving{transition-duration:.2s}}

/* Portada móvil: identidad y acceso en un bloque breve. */
@media(max-width:640px){
  .entry-inner{gap:10px;padding:14px 18px}
  .entry-title{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,8vw,2.45rem);letter-spacing:.035em}
  .entry-flag{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.14em;line-height:1.35}
  .entry-actions .entry-button{min-height:44px;padding:.72em 1.35em;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.14em}
}
</style>
<script src="../ana-klaudya/publication.js"></script>
</head>

<body class="locked" data-publication="web">

<button class="entry-button piece-button" id="anaEstrella" type="button"><span class="piece-art" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 300 64" preserveAspectRatio="xMaxYMid slice"><image href="../estrella/umbral.jpg" width="300" height="200" y="-70"/><g transform="translate(251 32)"><circle r="23" fill="#ece8d8"/><path d="M0-23a23 23 0 0 1 0 46a11.5 11.5 0 0 1 0-23a11.5 11.5 0 0 0 0-23" fill="#17202a"/><circle cy="-11.5" r="3.3" fill="#17202a"/><circle cy="11.5" r="3.3" fill="#ece8d8"/></g></svg></span><span class="piece-shade" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="piece-label">Prólogo · Siguiendo una tarjeta</span></button>
<button class="entry-button piece-button" id="anaRead" type="button"><span class="piece-art" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="610 760 600 640" preserveAspectRatio="xMaxYMid meet"><image href="ana-klaudya-fotografia.jpg" width="1228" height="2048"/></svg></span><span class="piece-shade" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="piece-label">Elegía breve para Ana Klaudya</span></button>
<button class="entry-button piece-button" id="anaOjos" type="button"><span class="piece-art" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="705 835 320 140" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"><image href="ana-klaudya-fotografia.jpg" width="1228" height="2048"/></svg></span><span class="piece-shade" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="piece-label">En tus ojos</span></button>
<button class="entry-button piece-button" id="anaSonrisa" type="button"><span class="piece-art" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="680 1035 265 140" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"><image href="ana-klaudya-fotografia.jpg" width="1228" height="2048"/></svg></span><span class="piece-shade" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="piece-label">En tus labios</span></button>
<button class="entry-button piece-button" id="anaCabello" type="button"><span class="piece-art" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="1010 680 210 230" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"><image href="ana-klaudya-fotografia.jpg" width="1228" height="2048"/></svg></span><span class="piece-shade" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="piece-label">Tu cabello</span></button>
<button class="entry-button piece-button" id="anaPiel" type="button"><span class="piece-art" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="855 1090 180 420" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"><image href="ana-klaudya-fotografia.jpg" width="1228" height="2048"/></svg></span><span class="piece-shade" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="piece-label">Tu piel</span></button>
<button class="entry-button petal-button piece-button" id="anaInterlude" type="button"><span class="piece-art" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="15 103 487 297" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"><image href="../interludio/mundo-flores.png" width="1536" height="1024"/></svg></span><span class="piece-shade" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="piece-label">Interludio · Iba a llevarte flores</span></button>
<button class="entry-button flambe-button" id="anaEpilogue" type="button">Epílogo · A fuego lento</button>
<button class="entry-button piece-button" id="anaVoice" type="button"><span class="piece-art" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 260 64" preserveAspectRatio="xMaxYMid slice"><g fill="none" stroke="#c6dfd8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".7"><path d="M18 29v6m10-12v18m10-22v26m10-16v6m10-25v44m10-33v22m10-15v8m10-27v46m10-35v24m10-19v14m10-10v6m10-24v42m10-28v14m10-11v8m10-28v48m10-34v20m10-18v16m10-12v8m10-20v32m10-23v14m10-10v6m10-17v28m10-22v16"/></g></svg></span><span class="piece-shade" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="piece-label">▶ Escuchar la elegía</span></button>
</nav>
</dialog>
<nav class="journey-nav" id="journeyNav" aria-label="Recorrido de la obra" hidden>
<button id="journeyPrevious" type="button">Anterior</button>
<button id="journeyIndexOpen" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog">Índice</button>
<button id="journeyNext" type="button">Siguiente</button>
</nav>

  <div id="poemBackdrop" class="poem-backdrop" aria-hidden="true" hidden></div>
  <iframe id="cenicientoFrame" class="ceniciento-frame" title="Ceniciento" allow="autoplay" hidden></iframe>

  <div class="entry" id="entry" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Entrada a Ana Klaudya">
    <div class="entry-inner">
      <p class="entry-title">ANA KLAUDYA</p>
      <p class="entry-flag">poemas de Paco Olmo de Males</p>
      <div class="entry-actions">
        <button class="entry-button" id="entryButton" type="button">▶ Comenzar</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <button class="entry-button voice-launch" id="voiceLaunch" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog">Voz</button>
  <dialog class="voice-dialog" id="voiceDialog" aria-labelledby="voiceTitle">
    <h2 id="voiceTitle">ANA KLAUDYA</h2>
    <audio id="recording" controls controlslist="nodownload" preload="metadata" src="recitado.m4a" aria-label="Recitado de Ana Klaudya">
      Tu navegador no admite la reproducción de audio.
    </audio>
    <div class="voice-mix" hidden>
      <label><input id="musicEnabled" type="checkbox" checked> Acompañar con música</label>
      <div class="music-level"><label for="musicLevel">Nivel de música</label><output id="musicLevelValue" for="musicLevel">80 %</output></div>
      <input id="musicLevel" type="range" min="0" max="80" value="80" step="1" aria-label="Nivel de música">
    </div>
    <p class="voice-status" id="voiceStatus" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <div class="entry-actions">
      <button class="entry-button" id="voicePlay" type="button">Activar voz</button>
      <button class="entry-button" id="voiceClose" type="button">Volver</button>
    </div>
  </dialog>

  <div class="name-prelude" id="namePrelude" aria-hidden="true">
    <p class="name-line"><span class="name-ana">Ana</span><span class="name-klaudya">Klaudya</span></p>
  </div>

  <button class="sound-toggle" id="soundToggle" type="button" aria-label="Silenciar sonido" aria-pressed="false" title="Sonido">
    <svg class="sound-on" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M9 18V6l9-2v12"></path>
      <circle cx="6.5" cy="18" r="2.5"></circle>
      <circle cx="15.5" cy="16" r="2.5"></circle>
    </svg>
    <svg class="sound-off" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M6 6l12 12"></path>
      <path d="M9 18V6l9-2v8"></path>
    </svg>
  </button>

  <div class="scroll-cue" aria-hidden="true"></div>

  <main id="reading">
    <div class="poem">
      <span class="line" data-stage="face">Había en su rostro</span>
      <span class="line g-opening-2">una belleza serena,</span>
      <span class="line g-comma">de las que no reclaman</span>
      <span class="line g-close">hacerse notar.</span>

      <span class="line g-eyes-2">La hondura de los ojos,</span>
      <span class="line g-comma">el trazo de la boca,</span>
      <span class="line g-comma">el cabello dispuesto</span>
      <span class="line g-close">con un cuidado</span>
      <span class="line g-soft">que subraya</span>
      <span class="line g-subraya-2">sin corregir.</span>

      <span class="line g-turn" id="voiceStart" data-stage="voice">Y luego habló.</span>
      <span class="line g-sentence">Brasil seguía intacto</span>
      <span class="line g-close">en su manera de decir:</span>
      <span class="line g-comma">el peso tibio de las vocales,</span>
      <span class="line g-comma">la sílaba demorada,</span>
      <span class="line g-comma">una música</span>
      <span class="line g-music-2a">que se negaba</span>
      <span class="line g-music-2b">a disimular.</span>

      <span class="line g-reflection-open">Entonces comprendí</span>
      <span class="line g-reflection-thought">que a la luz de aquel rostro</span>
      <span class="line g-reflection-suspense">le faltaba todavía</span>
      <span class="line g-reflection-voice">la <span class="voice-word">voz</span>.</span>

      <span class="line g-deep" id="embraceStart" data-stage="embrace">Después vino</span>
      <span class="line g-close">el abrazo.</span>
      <span class="line g-embrace-a">Ignoro cuánto duró</span>
      <span class="line g-embrace-b">o quién se acercó primero.</span>
      <span class="line g-embrace-c">Solo recuerdo</span>
      <span class="line g-embrace-d heat-one">el calor.</span>

      <span class="line g-deep" id="memoryStart" data-stage="memory">Y quedó también</span>
      <span class="line g-soft">esa íntima injusticia</span>
      <span class="line g-comma">que a veces comete la memoria:</span>
      <span class="line g-sentence">de toda una tarde</span>
      <span class="line g-close">retiene intacto</span>
      <span class="line g-soft">un rostro,</span>
      <span class="line g-deep">y de todo un abrazo,</span>

      <span class="heat-anchor" id="finalHeatAnchor">
        <span class="line heat-final" id="finalHeat">
          <span class="heat-part heat-el">el</span>
          <span class="heat-part heat-calor">calor.</span>
        </span>
      </span>

      <div class="epilogue-invitation" id="epilogueInvitation" hidden><button class="entry-button flambe-button" id="readEpilogue" type="button">Epílogo · A fuego lento →</button></div>
    </div>
  </main>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const root = document.documentElement;
      const body = document.body;
      const entry = document.getElementById('entry');
      const entryButton = document.getElementById('entryButton');
      const namePrelude = document.getElementById('namePrelude');
      const pulseField = document.getElementById('pulseField');
      const soundtrack = document.getElementById('voiceMusic');
      const soundToggle = document.getElementById('soundToggle');
      const voiceDialog = document.getElementById('voiceDialog');
      const recording = document.getElementById('recording');
      const voicePlay = document.getElementById('voicePlay');
      const voiceStatus = document.getElementById('voiceStatus');
      const nameAudio = document.getElementById('nameAudio');
      const voiceMusic = document.getElementById('voiceMusic');
      const musicEnabled = document.getElementById('musicEnabled');
      const musicLevel = document.getElementById('musicLevel');
      const anaPortrait=document.getElementById('anaPortrait');
      const portraitFinale=document.getElementById('portraitFinale');
      let completedVoicePasses=0, listeningStart=null, listeningEnd=0;
      let listenedRanges=[], portraitRequested=false, portraitRevealTimer=null;
      let questionGrowthActive=false,questionGrowth=.22,questionNext=.22;
      let finalCalorTimer=null,finalPortraitTimer=null;
      const growQuestionOnHeartbeat=()=>{
        if(!questionGrowthActive || !body.classList.contains('portrait-revealed') || body.classList.contains('ceniciento-open'))return;
        questionGrowth=questionNext;questionNext=Math.min(1,questionGrowth+.12);
        root.style.setProperty('--question-current',questionGrowth.toFixed(3));
        root.style.setProperty('--question-first',Math.min(1,questionGrowth+.06).toFixed(3));
        root.style.setProperty('--question-next',questionNext.toFixed(3));
      };
      const revealPortrait=()=>{
        if(body.classList.contains('portrait-revealed')) return;
        portraitRequested=true;
        const reveal=()=>{
          if(!anaPortrait.naturalWidth) return;
          portraitFinale.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
          body.classList.add('portrait-revealed');
          anaNavigation.hidden=true;
          body.classList.remove('ana-navigation-ready');
          clearTimeout(portraitRevealTimer);
          portraitRevealTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
            if(!body.classList.contains('portrait-revealed') || !cenicientoFrame.hidden)return;
            questionGrowthActive=true;
            anaNavigation.hidden=false;
            body.classList.add('ana-navigation-ready');
          },25000);
        };
        if(anaPortrait.complete) reveal();
        else anaPortrait.addEventListener('load',reveal,{once:true});
      };
      let mixContext=null, musicGain=null;
      let ambientLevel=Number(musicLevel.value)/100;
      let nameFrame=0, namePriming=false;
      let voicePending=false, voicePriming=false, voiceAllowed=false;
      let voiceTimer=null, voiceRequest=0;
      const TRANSITION_SECONDS=4;
      const musicLimit=()=>Number(musicLevel.value)/100;
      const voiceBedLimit=()=>musicLimit()*.8;
      const showMusicLevel=level=>{
        musicLevel.value=String(Math.round(level*100));
        document.getElementById('musicLevelValue').textContent=musicLevel.value+' %';
      };
      const fadeMusicTo=(target,seconds=TRANSITION_SECONDS)=>{
        if(musicGain){
          const gain=musicGain.gain,now=mixContext.currentTime;
          if(gain.cancelAndHoldAtTime) gain.cancelAndHoldAtTime(now);
          else {const value=gain.value;gain.cancelScheduledValues(now);gain.setValueAtTime(value,now);}
          gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(target,now+seconds);
        }else voiceMusic.volume=target;
      };
      const prepareMix=()=>{
        if(!mixContext){
          const Context=window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
          if(!Context) return false;
          mixContext=new Context();
          musicGain=mixContext.createGain();musicGain.gain.value=voiceMusic.paused ? 0 : voiceMusic.volume;
          mixContext.createMediaElementSource(recording).connect(mixContext.destination);
          mixContext.createMediaElementSource(nameAudio).connect(mixContext.destination);
          mixContext.createMediaElementSource(voiceMusic).connect(musicGain).connect(mixContext.destination);
          voiceMusic.volume=1;
        }
        if(mixContext.state==='suspended') mixContext.resume().catch(()=>{});
        return true;
      };
      const ambientButtons=show=>{if(show){body.classList.add('sound-ready');syncSoundToggle();}};
      const ensureAmbientMusic=()=>{
        if(!musicEnabled.checked) return Promise.resolve(false);
        voiceMusic.muted=false;
        if(!mixContext) voiceMusic.volume=musicLimit();
        const playback=voiceMusic.paused ? voiceMusic.play() : Promise.resolve();
        return playback.then(()=>{
          ambientButtons(false);soundStarted=true;body.classList.add('sound-ready');syncSoundToggle();return true;
        }).catch(()=>{ambientButtons(true);return false;});
      };
      const restoreAmbient=()=>{
        showMusicLevel(ambientLevel);
        if(soundStarted && musicEnabled.checked){
          fadeMusicTo(ambientLevel);
          ensureAmbientMusic();
        }else fadeMusicTo(0);
      };
      const cancelVoiceStart=()=>{
        voiceRequest++;
        clearTimeout(voiceTimer);voiceTimer=null;voicePending=false;voiceAllowed=false;
        voicePlay.textContent='Activar voz';voiceStatus.textContent='';restoreAmbient();
      };
      const playRecording=()=>{
        if(voicePending) return;
        const request=++voiceRequest,playhead=recording.ended ? 0 : recording.currentTime;
        const muted=recording.muted;
        prepareMix();
        voicePending=true;voicePriming=true;voiceAllowed=false;
        voicePlay.textContent='Cancelar';
        voiceStatus.textContent='La música desciende suavemente…';
        if(musicEnabled.checked && voiceMusic.paused && musicGain){
          musicGain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(mixContext.currentTime);
          musicGain.gain.setValueAtTime(musicLimit(),mixContext.currentTime);
        }
        ensureAmbientMusic();
        // Unlock media playback in this user gesture, preserving the first word.
        recording.muted=true;
        recording.play().then(()=>{
          recording.pause();recording.currentTime=playhead;recording.muted=muted;voicePriming=false;
          if(request!==voiceRequest) return;
          if(musicEnabled.checked){
            const target=voiceBedLimit();
            fadeMusicTo(target);
            showMusicLevel(target);
          }
          voiceTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
            if(request!==voiceRequest || !voiceDialog.open) return;
            voiceTimer=null;voicePending=false;voiceAllowed=true;
            recording.play().catch(()=>{
              voiceAllowed=false;voicePlay.textContent='Activar voz';restoreAmbient();
              voiceStatus.textContent='Pulsa Activar voz para volver a intentarlo.';
            });
          },musicEnabled.checked ? TRANSITION_SECONDS*1000 : 0);
        }).catch(()=>{
          recording.muted=muted;voicePriming=false;voicePending=false;voiceAllowed=false;
          voicePlay.textContent='Activar voz';restoreAmbient();
          voiceStatus.textContent='Pulsa Activar voz para iniciar la grabación.';
        });
      };
      const startMix=()=>{
        if(voicePending || recording.paused || voicePriming) return;
        if(!musicEnabled.checked){fadeMusicTo(0);return;}
        if(!prepareMix()) return;
        ensureAmbientMusic();
      };
            musicEnabled.addEventListener('change',()=>{
        if(musicEnabled.checked){
          prepareMix();fadeMusicTo(musicLimit());ensureAmbientMusic();startMix();
        }else {fadeMusicTo(0);ambientButtons(false);}
      });
      musicLevel.addEventListener('input',()=>{
        ambientLevel=musicLimit();
        document.getElementById('musicLevelValue').textContent=musicLevel.value+' %';
        fadeMusicTo(musicEnabled.checked ? musicLimit() : 0,.5);
      });
      recording.addEventListener('playing',startMix);
      recording.addEventListener('contextmenu',event=>event.preventDefault());
      const saveListenedRange=()=>{
        if(listeningStart!==null && listeningEnd>listeningStart){
          listenedRanges.push([listeningStart,listeningEnd]);
        }
        listeningStart=null;
      };
      recording.addEventListener('playing',()=>{
        if(voicePriming || voicePending) return;
        listeningStart=recording.currentTime;listeningEnd=listeningStart;
      });
      recording.addEventListener('timeupdate',()=>{
        if(listeningStart===null || voicePriming || recording.seeking) return;
        listeningEnd=recording.currentTime;
      });
      recording.addEventListener('seeking',saveListenedRange);
      recording.addEventListener('seeked',()=>{
        if(recording.paused || voicePriming || voicePending) return;
        listeningStart=recording.currentTime;listeningEnd=listeningStart;
      });
      recording.addEventListener('pause',()=>{
        if(voicePriming || voicePending || recording.seeking) return;
        if(listeningStart!==null) listeningEnd=recording.currentTime;
        saveListenedRange();
      });
      const finishVoicePass=()=>{
        if(listeningStart!==null) listeningEnd=recording.currentTime;
        saveListenedRange();
        completedVoicePasses++;
        // Give the last two verses a visible pause before the photograph.
        finalHeat.classList.add('is-shown');
        startFinalSequence();
        clearTimeout(finalPortraitTimer);
        finalPortraitTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
          finalPortraitTimer=null;
          if(cenicientoFrame.hidden && body.classList.contains('reading-ready'))revealPortrait();
        },finalHeat.classList.contains('show-calor') ? 4000 : 8500);
        listenedRanges=[];listeningStart=null;
      };

        anaNavigation.hidden=true;body.classList.add('ceniciento-open');root.classList.add('ceniciento-open');document.title=({ceniciento:'CENICIENTO · leer o escuchar',ojos:'EN TUS OJOS',sonrisa:'EN TUS LABIOS',cabello:'TU CABELLO',piel:'TU PIEL',estrella:'SIGUIENDO UNA TARJETA',epilogo:'A FUEGO LENTO · EPÍLOGO',interludio:'IBA A LLEVARTE FLORES · INTERLUDIO'})[piece];

        if(window.location.hash!=='#'+piece)window.history.pushState({piece},'','#'+piece);

      const startWarmPrelude=()=>{

        root.style.setProperty('--warm',warmTakeover.toFixed(3));
      });

        if(finalSequenceStarted) return;
        finalSequenceStarted=true;

        /* "el": primera señal térmica, preparación */

      const revealLines=()=>{
        if(!readingReady || !hasScrolled) return;

        const revealY=window.innerHeight*.48;

          const rect=line.getBoundingClientRect();

          if(rect.top<=revealY && (rect.bottom>0 || line===finalHeat)){
            line.classList.add('is-shown');

            if(line===finalHeat){

            }
          }
        });
      };

      const stageProgress=element=>{
        const rect=element.getBoundingClientRect();
        return ramp(window.innerHeight-rect.top,0,window.innerHeight*1.25);
      };

      const renderWorld=()=>{
        if(!readingReady){
          root.style.setProperty('--green','0');
          root.style.setProperty('--deep','0');
          root.style.setProperty('--billiard','0');
          root.style.setProperty('--warm',warmTakeover.toFixed(3));
          return;
        }

        const voice=stageProgress(voiceStart);
        const embrace=stageProgress(embraceStart);
        const memory=stageProgress(memoryStart);
        const finalStage=stageProgress(finalHeat);

        const greenBase=Math.min(.58,.10+voice*.34+embrace*.14);
        const deepBase=Math.min(.46,embrace*.25+memory*.21);
        const billiardBase=Math.min(.76,memory*.34+finalStage*.42);

        const warmFade=1-warmTakeover*.62;
        const green=greenBase*warmFade;
        const deep=deepBase*(1-warmTakeover*.46);
        const billiard=billiardBase*(1-warmTakeover*.68);

        root.style.setProperty('--green',green.toFixed(3));
        root.style.setProperty('--deep',deep.toFixed(3));
        root.style.setProperty('--billiard',billiard.toFixed(3));
        root.style.setProperty('--warm',warmTakeover.toFixed(3));

        const heat=smooth(clamp((window.innerHeight*.88-heatRect.top)/(window.innerHeight*.48)));

        let r,g,b;

        if(heat<.48){
          const t=heat/.48;
          r=Math.round(205+(220-205)*t);
          g=Math.round(118+(142-118)*t);
          b=Math.round(86+(110-86)*t);
        }else{
          const t=(heat-.48)/.52;
          r=Math.round(220+(232-220)*t);
          g=Math.round(142+(156-142)*t);
          b=Math.round(110+(126-110)*t);
        }

        root.style.setProperty('--heat-r',String(r));
        root.style.setProperty('--heat-g',String(g));
        root.style.setProperty('--heat-b',String(b));
        root.style.setProperty('--heat-glow',heat.toFixed(3));

        finalHeat.classList.toggle(
          'is-burning',

        );
      };

      const onScroll=()=>{

        }

        if(!ticking){

          requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
            revealLines();
            renderWorld();
            ticking=false;
          });
        }
      };

      window.addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});
      window.addEventListener('resize',onScroll);

      syncSoundToggle();
      renderWorld();
      syncPoemRoute();
    })();
  </script>
`````

`````javascript
const ana=fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'index.html'),'utf8');
const sharedCode=fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname,'../narrative-universe.js'),'utf8');
const match=star.match(/<article class="poem" id="poem"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/article>/);
assert(match,'The star poem has a distinct reading container');
const phrases=[...match[1].matchAll(/<p class="phrase hidden-phrase(?: ending(?: final-stanza)?)?"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/p>/g)]
 .map(m=>m[1].replace(/<br\s*\/?\s*>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim());
assert.deepEqual(phrases,[
 'Siguiendo una tarjeta, encontré un lugar.',
 'Al detenerme allí, empezó a ser mi hogar (todavía sin llave, pero ya imaginaba mis pasos al volver)',
 'Siguiendo a un ángel, llegué hasta ti.',
 'Todavía me sorprende.',
 'Cuando era yang, buscaba el yin.',
 'Ahora que soy yin,',
 'me basta con mirarte.'
],'The complete seven-part prologue remains in its intended order');
assert(match[0].includes('aria-label="Siguiendo una tarjeta" hidden'),'The poem waits behind its celestial opening');
assert(star.includes('function completeMoon()'),'The transition has an explicit completion gate');
assert(star.includes("poem.hidden=false;paced.disabled=false"),'Text is revealed only when the opening completes');
assert(star.includes("document.getElementById('backAna').addEventListener('click'"),'The prologue returns within Ana Klaudya');
assert(ana.includes('id="anaEstrella"'),'The prologue remains part of Ana Klaudya navigation');
assert(!/makeSymbolic|wrapToken/.test(sharedCode),'The shared system does not turn this motif into a cross-work shortcut');
assert(!/Torre Eiffel|Ojos de estatua|tarjeta anulada|reloj/.test(star),'No secondary motif becomes a link from the prologue');
console.log('PASS: complete seven-part prologue, gated reveal and internal return');
`````

`````html
 if(index===lines.length){mode='done';paced.textContent='Volver a leer';status.textContent='Silencio.';return}
 const line=lines[index++];line.classList.remove('hidden-line');
 timer=setTimeout(reveal,Number(line.dataset.wait));
}
paced.addEventListener('click',()=>{
 if(mode==='playing'){clear();mode='paused';paced.textContent='Continuar';status.textContent='Una pausa, a tu elección.';return}
 if(mode==='paused'){mode='playing';paced.textContent='Pausar';status.textContent='Deja respirar cada verso.';reveal();return}
 clear();index=0;lines.forEach(l=>l.classList.add('hidden-line'));mode='playing';paced.textContent='Pausar';status.textContent='Deja respirar cada verso.';reveal();
});
full.addEventListener('click',()=>{clear();mode='full';lines.forEach(l=>l.classList.remove('hidden-line'));paced.textContent='Leer con pausas';status.textContent='A tu ritmo.'});
`````

`````html
</p>

<span class="line" data-wait="2400">Tu sonrisa comienza en las comisuras:</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">un leve movimiento</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">y se me olvida</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="4200">cómo iba a empezar.</span>
</p>
<p class="stanza">
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">El gesto se extiende por tu rostro.</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">Yo también sonrío.</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="4200">Todavía no has dicho nada.</span>
</p>
<p class="stanza">
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">Vuelves a sonreír.</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">Lo que iba a decirte</span>
<span class="line ending" data-wait="4200">puede esperar.</span>
</p>

<script>
const inheritedMusic=window.parent!==window && new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('music')==='parent';
const musicLevel=document.getElementById('musicLevel'),musicEnabled=document.getElementById('musicEnabled'),musicValue=document.getElementById('musicValue'),musicStart=document.getElementById('musicStart');
const sendMusic=type=>window.parent.postMessage({channel:'ceniciento-music-v1',type,level:Number(musicLevel.value)/100,enabled:musicEnabled.checked},location.origin);
musicLevel.addEventListener('input',()=>{musicValue.textContent=musicLevel.value+' %';sendMusic('level')});
musicEnabled.addEventListener('change',()=>sendMusic('enabled'));
musicStart.addEventListener('click',()=>{musicEnabled.checked=true;sendMusic('enabled');sendMusic('start')});
document.getElementById('backAna').addEventListener('click',event=>{
 if(!inheritedMusic || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey)return;
 event.preventDefault();sendMusic('home');
});
window.addEventListener('message',event=>{
 if(event.origin!==location.origin || event.source!==window.parent || event.data?.channel!=='ceniciento-music-v1' || event.data.type!=='state')return;
 if(Number.isFinite(event.data.pulseTime) && !document.body.dataset.pulseSynced){
 document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--pulse-delay',(-((event.data.pulseTime%1850)/1000))+'s');
 document.body.dataset.pulseSynced='true';
}
 musicLevel.value=String(Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(.8,Number(event.data.level)||0))*100));
 musicValue.textContent=musicLevel.value+' %';musicEnabled.checked=!!event.data.enabled;
 musicStart.hidden=!musicEnabled.checked || !!event.data.playing;
});
if(inheritedMusic)sendMusic('ready');
const lines=[...document.querySelectorAll('.line')];
const paced=document.getElementById('paced'),full=document.getElementById('full'),status=document.getElementById('status');
let timer=null,index=0,mode='full';
function clear(){clearTimeout(timer);timer=null}
function reveal(){
 if(mode!=='playing')return;
 if(index===lines.length){mode='done';paced.textContent='Volver a leer';status.textContent='Silencio.';return}
 const line=lines[index++];line.classList.remove('hidden-line');
 timer=setTimeout(reveal,Number(line.dataset.wait));
}
paced.addEventListener('click',()=>{
 if(mode==='playing'){clear();mode='paused';paced.textContent='Continuar';status.textContent='Una pausa, a tu elección.';return}
 if(mode==='paused'){mode='playing';paced.textContent='Pausar';status.textContent='Deja respirar cada verso.';reveal();return}
 clear();index=0;lines.forEach(l=>l.classList.add('hidden-line'));mode='playing';paced.textContent='Pausar';status.textContent='Deja respirar cada verso.';reveal();
});
full.addEventListener('click',()=>{clear();mode='full';lines.forEach(l=>l.classList.remove('hidden-line'));paced.textContent='Leer con pausas';status.textContent='A tu ritmo.'});
</script>
`````

`````html
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">Negro, con ese brillo de crin</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">que estalla al volver la cabeza:</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">la luz resbala por él</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="4200">sin llegar a aclararlo.</span>
</p>
<p class="stanza">
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">Cae sobre tu hombro</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">y tarda en quedarse quieto.</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">Tú regresas a tus palabras;</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">pero un mechón prolonga</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="4200">el giro de tu rostro.</span>
</p>
<p class="stanza">
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">Lo apartas con los dedos.</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">El gesto desnuda tu cuello</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">y deja entre las hebras</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="4200">una grieta de luz.</span>
</p>
<p class="stanza">
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">Sigues hablando.</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">El mechón vuelve a su sitio.</span>
<span class="line" data-wait="2400">Yo tardo</span>
<span class="line ending" data-wait="4200">un poco más.</span>
</p>
</article>
</main>

<script>
const detailBackground=document.querySelector('.detail-background');
const detailPhoto=new Image();
const clarifyDetail=()=>{requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{setTimeout(()=>{detailBackground.classList.add('is-clear');document.body.classList.add('detail-clear')},350)}));};
detailPhoto.addEventListener('load',clarifyDetail,{once:true});
detailPhoto.src='../elegia-breve/ana-klaudya-fotografia.jpg';
const inheritedMusic=window.parent!==window && new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('music')==='parent';
const musicLevel=document.getElementById('musicLevel'),musicEnabled=document.getElementById('musicEnabled'),musicValue=document.getElementById('musicValue'),musicStart=document.getElementById('musicStart');
const sendMusic=type=>window.parent.postMessage({channel:'ceniciento-music-v1',type,level:Number(musicLevel.value)/100,enabled:musicEnabled.checked},location.origin);
musicLevel.addEventListener('input',()=>{musicValue.textContent=musicLevel.value+' %';sendMusic('level')});
musicEnabled.addEventListener('change',()=>sendMusic('enabled'));
musicStart.addEventListener('click',()=>{musicEnabled.checked=true;sendMusic('enabled');sendMusic('start')});
document.getElementById('backAna').addEventListener('click',event=>{
 if(!inheritedMusic || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey)return;
 event.preventDefault();sendMusic('home');
});
window.addEventListener('message',event=>{
 if(event.origin!==location.origin || event.source!==window.parent || event.data?.channel!=='ceniciento-music-v1' || event.data.type!=='state')return;

 musicLevel.value=String(Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(.8,Number(event.data.level)||0))*100));
 musicValue.textContent=musicLevel.value+' %';musicEnabled.checked=!!event.data.enabled;
 musicStart.hidden=!musicEnabled.checked || !!event.data.playing;
});
if(inheritedMusic)sendMusic('ready');
const lines=[...document.querySelectorAll('.line')];
const paced=document.getElementById('paced'),full=document.getElementById('full'),status=document.getElementById('status');
let timer=null,index=0,mode='full';
function clear(){clearTimeout(timer);timer=null}
function reveal(){
 if(mode!=='playing')return;
 if(index===lines.length){mode='done';paced.textContent='Volver a leer';status.textContent='Silencio.';return}
 const line=lines[index++];line.classList.remove('hidden-line');
 timer=setTimeout(reveal,Number(line.dataset.wait));
}
paced.addEventListener('click',()=>{
 if(mode==='playing'){clear();mode='paused';paced.textContent='Continuar';status.textContent='Una pausa, a tu elección.';return}
 if(mode==='paused'){mode='playing';paced.textContent='Pausar';status.textContent='Deja respirar cada verso.';reveal();return}
 clear();index=0;lines.forEach(l=>l.classList.add('hidden-line'));mode='playing';paced.textContent='Pausar';status.textContent='Deja respirar cada verso.';reveal();
});
full.addEventListener('click',()=>{clear();mode='full';lines.forEach(l=>l.classList.remove('hidden-line'));paced.textContent='Leer con pausas';status.textContent='A tu ritmo.'});
</script>
</body>
</html>
`````

`````html
<main>
<section class="intro" aria-labelledby="title">
<div class="kicker">Prólogo · Ana Klaudya</div>
<h1 id="title">Siguiendo<br><em>una tarjeta.</em></h1>
<div class="rule" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<div class="controls">
<button class="primary" id="paced" type="button" disabled>Esperando a la luna</button>
</div>
<p class="status" id="status" role="status">La luna se está formando.</p>
<div class="music-controls">
<button id="musicStart" type="button">Activar música</button>
<label><input id="musicEnabled" type="checkbox" checked> Música de fondo</label>
<label for="musicLevel">Volumen <output id="musicValue">30 %</output></label>
<input id="musicLevel" type="range" min="0" max="80" value="30">
</div>
</section>
<article class="poem" id="poem" aria-label="Siguiendo una tarjeta" hidden>
<p class="phrase hidden-phrase" aria-hidden="true" data-wait="6200">Siguiendo una tarjeta,<br>
encontré un lugar.</p>
<p class="phrase hidden-phrase" aria-hidden="true" data-wait="12000">Al detenerme allí,<br>
empezó a ser mi hogar<br>
(todavía sin llave,<br>
pero ya imaginaba<br>
mis pasos al volver)</p>
<p class="phrase hidden-phrase" aria-hidden="true" data-wait="6200">Siguiendo a un ángel,<br>
llegué hasta ti.</p>
<p class="phrase hidden-phrase" aria-hidden="true" data-wait="4000">Todavía me sorprende.</p>
<p class="phrase hidden-phrase" aria-hidden="true" data-wait="6500">Cuando era <em>yang</em>,<br>
buscaba el <em>yin</em>.</p>
<p class="phrase hidden-phrase" aria-hidden="true" data-wait="3200">Ahora que soy <em>yin</em>,</p>
<p class="phrase hidden-phrase ending final-stanza" aria-hidden="true" data-wait="7000">me basta con mirarte.</p>
</article>
</main>

<script>

const celestialScene=document.getElementById('celestialScene');
const worldComet=document.getElementById('worldComet');
let celestialTimers=[];
let moonReady=false;
function beginCelestialJourney(delay=3600){
 celestialTimers.forEach(clearTimeout);celestialTimers=[];
 clear();moonReady=false;mode='waiting';index=0;poem.hidden=true;
 phrases.forEach(phrase=>{phrase.classList.add('hidden-phrase');phrase.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')});
 paced.disabled=true;paced.textContent='Esperando a la luna';status.textContent='La luna se está formando.';
 celestialScene.classList.add('is-resetting');
 celestialScene.classList.remove('is-awake','is-home');worldComet.classList.remove('is-active');
 void celestialScene.offsetWidth;
 celestialScene.classList.remove('is-resetting');
 if(window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')?.matches){celestialScene.classList.add('is-awake','is-home');completeMoon();return;}
 celestialTimers=[setTimeout(()=>{
  worldComet.classList.add('is-active');
  celestialScene.classList.add('is-awake','is-home');
  // The last lunar transition is the 10-second glow. Never reveal text early.
  celestialTimers.push(setTimeout(completeMoon,10050));
 },delay)];
}
document.getElementById('homeMoon').addEventListener('transitionend',event=>{
 if(event.target===event.currentTarget && event.propertyName==='box-shadow' && celestialScene.classList.contains('is-home'))completeMoon();
});
const detailBackground=document.querySelector('.detail-background');
const detailPhoto=new Image();
const clarifyDetail=()=>{requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{setTimeout(()=>{detailBackground.classList.add('is-clear');document.body.classList.add('detail-clear')},175)}));};
detailPhoto.addEventListener('load',clarifyDetail,{once:true});
detailPhoto.src='umbral.jpg?v=20261006-sin-estrella-fija';
const inheritedMusic=window.parent!==window && new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('music')==='parent';
const asPrologue=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('prologue')==='1';
if(asPrologue)document.getElementById('backAna').hidden=true;
const musicLevel=document.getElementById('musicLevel'),musicEnabled=document.getElementById('musicEnabled'),musicValue=document.getElementById('musicValue'),musicStart=document.getElementById('musicStart');
const sendMusic=type=>window.parent.postMessage({channel:'ceniciento-music-v1',type,level:Number(musicLevel.value)/100,enabled:musicEnabled.checked},location.origin);
musicLevel.addEventListener('input',()=>{musicValue.textContent=musicLevel.value+' %';sendMusic('level')});
musicEnabled.addEventListener('change',()=>sendMusic('enabled'));
musicStart.addEventListener('click',()=>{musicEnabled.checked=true;sendMusic('enabled');sendMusic('start')});
document.getElementById('backAna').addEventListener('click',event=>{
 if(!inheritedMusic || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey)return;
 event.preventDefault();sendMusic('home');
});
window.addEventListener('message',event=>{
 if(event.origin!==location.origin || event.source!==window.parent || event.data?.channel!=='ceniciento-music-v1' || event.data.type!=='state')return;

 musicLevel.value=String(Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(.8,Number(event.data.level)||0))*100));
 musicValue.textContent=musicLevel.value+' %';musicEnabled.checked=!!event.data.enabled;
 musicStart.hidden=!musicEnabled.checked || !!event.data.playing;
});
if(inheritedMusic)sendMusic('ready');
const phrases=[...document.querySelectorAll('.phrase')];
const poem=document.getElementById('poem');
const paced=document.getElementById('paced'),status=document.getElementById('status');
let timer=null,index=0,mode='waiting';
function clear(){clearTimeout(timer);timer=null}
function completeMoon(){
 if(moonReady || mode!=='waiting')return;
 moonReady=true;poem.hidden=false;paced.disabled=false;
 mode='playing';paced.textContent='Pausar';status.textContent='Deja respirar cada frase.';reveal();
}
function reveal(){
 if(!moonReady || mode!=='playing')return;
 if(index===phrases.length){mode='done';paced.textContent='Volver a leer';status.textContent='Silencio.';return}
 const phrase=phrases[index++];phrase.classList.remove('hidden-phrase');phrase.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
 timer=setTimeout(reveal,Number(phrase.dataset.wait));
}
paced.addEventListener('click',()=>{
 if(!moonReady)return;
 if(mode==='playing'){clear();mode='paused';paced.textContent='Continuar';status.textContent='Una pausa, a tu elección.';return}
 if(mode==='paused'){mode='playing';paced.textContent='Pausar';status.textContent='Deja respirar cada frase.';reveal();return}
 beginCelestialJourney(150);
});
beginCelestialJourney();
</script>
`````

`````html
<script>
const shots=[...document.querySelectorAll('.shot')];
const moonBridge=document.getElementById('moonBridge');
const epilogueOpening=document.getElementById('epilogueOpening');
const pause=document.getElementById('pause'),replay=document.getElementById('replay'),status=document.getElementById('status');
// The flower opens, scale accelerates, the impossible garden lingers, and the onion returns us to the table.
const cueStarts=[0,2800,4600,6300,9300,13300],duration=30000;
const fadeIn=[600,260,100,380,450,500],fadeOut=[360,130,180,420,400,600];
const morphStart=10700,morphEnd=15900;
const openingStarts=[17000,20500],openingFade=1600,ignitionStart=23500,ignitionEnd=27000,outroStart=26000;
const reducedMotion=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const inheritedMusic=window.parent!==window&&new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('music')==='parent';
const sendMusic=(type,details={})=>{if(inheritedMusic)window.parent.postMessage({channel:'ceniciento-music-v1',type,...details},location.origin)};
let elapsed=0,last=0,frame=0,introTimer=null,running=false,ready=false,finished=false,openingReady=false,promoted=false;
const smoothAmount=value=>{const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,value));return t*t*(3-2*t)};
function render(){
 const sceneFade=reducedMotion?(elapsed>=duration?0:1):1-smoothAmount((elapsed-outroStart)/(duration-outroStart));
 epilogueOpening.style.opacity='1';
 epilogueOpening.contentWindow?.postMessage({channel:'ana-opening-v1',type:'progress',backdrop:1-sceneFade,ignition:reducedMotion?(elapsed>=ignitionEnd?1:0):smoothAmount((elapsed-ignitionStart)/(ignitionEnd-ignitionStart)),levels:openingStarts.map(start=>reducedMotion?(elapsed>=start?1:0):Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(elapsed-start)/openingFade)))},location.origin);
 moonBridge.setAttribute('transform','translate(0 0)');
 const index=cueStarts.reduce((found,start,i)=>elapsed>=start?i:found,0);
 const into=elapsed-cueStarts[index],until=(cueStarts[index+1]??duration)-elapsed;
 // The first four cuts pass through darkness; the last pair shares one matched frame.
 if(elapsed>=morphStart){
  const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(elapsed-morphStart)/(morphEnd-morphStart)));
  const blend=reducedMotion?(elapsed>=morphEnd?1:0):t*t*(3-2*t);
  const descent=Math.min(1,t*2),settle=descent*descent*(3-2*descent);
  moonBridge.setAttribute('transform',`translate(${-27*settle} ${131*settle})`);
  // Keep the world opaque underneath the incoming onion to avoid a luminance dip.
  shots.forEach((shot,i)=>{shot.classList.toggle('active',i===index);shot.style.opacity=String(sceneFade*(i===4?(blend<1?1:0):i===5?blend:0));});
  return;
 }
 const incoming=(into-(index===0?0:80))/fadeIn[index];
 const outgoing=(until-90)/fadeOut[index];
 const amount=reducedMotion?1:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,incoming,outgoing));
 const opacity=amount*amount*(3-2*amount);
 shots.forEach((shot,i)=>{shot.classList.toggle('active',i===index);shot.style.opacity=String(i===index?opacity:0);});
}
function setPauseLabel(label,paused=false){pause.setAttribute('aria-label',label);pause.setAttribute('title',label);pause.setAttribute('data-state',paused?'paused':'playing');}
function stop(){running=false;clearTimeout(introTimer);introTimer=null;cancelAnimationFrame(frame);frame=0;last=0;}
function tick(now){
 if(!running)return;
 if(last&&!document.hidden)elapsed+=now-last;
 last=now;render();
 if(elapsed>=duration){stop();finished=true;setPauseLabel('Continuar',true);status.textContent='A fuego lento.';sendMusic('interlude-ended',{openingShown:true,persistentOpening:openingReady});return;}
 frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}
function start(){if(!ready||running)return;clearTimeout(introTimer);introTimer=null;running=true;last=0;render();setPauseLabel('Pausar');status.textContent='';frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick);}
function reset(){stop();elapsed=0;finished=false;epilogueOpening.contentWindow?.postMessage({channel:'ana-opening-v1',type:'reset'},location.origin);render();start();}
pause.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(running||introTimer!==null){stop();setPauseLabel('Continuar',true);status.textContent='Una pausa, a tu elección.';}else if(finished)reset();else start();});
replay.addEventListener('click',reset);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{last=0;});
window.addEventListener('pagehide',stop);
let loadedImages=0;
for(const path of ['mundo-flores.png','mundo-flores-yin-yang.png','cebolla-pan.png']){
 const image=new Image();
 image.addEventListener('load',()=>{if(++loadedImages===3){ready=true;pause.disabled=false;replay.disabled=false;introTimer=setTimeout(start,850);}},{once:true});
 image.addEventListener('error',()=>{status.textContent='No se han podido cargar las imágenes. Puedes continuar al epílogo con Siguiente.';},{once:true});
 image.src=path;
}
epilogueOpening.addEventListener('load',()=>render());
window.addEventListener('message',event=>{
 if(event.origin!==location.origin)return;
 if(event.source===epilogueOpening.contentWindow && event.data?.channel==='ana-opening-v1' && event.data.type==='ready'){
  openingReady=true;render();sendMusic('ready');sendMusic('interlude-preview-ready');return;
 }
 if(event.source===epilogueOpening.contentWindow && event.data?.channel==='ceniciento-music-v1'){
  if(['ready','home','close','level','enabled','start'].includes(event.data.type))window.parent.postMessage(event.data,location.origin);
  return;
 }
 if(event.source===window.parent && event.data?.channel==='ceniciento-music-v1'){
  if(event.data.type==='continue-epilogue'&&openingReady&&!promoted){
   stop();promoted=true;document.body.classList.add('epilogue-active');
   epilogueOpening.contentWindow?.postMessage({channel:'ana-opening-v1',type:'continue'},location.origin);return;
  }
  if(event.data.type==='state')epilogueOpening.contentWindow?.postMessage(event.data,location.origin);
 }
});
sendMusic('ready');
</script>
`````
